item.title: The tax mitigation industry is now just as much about hype and exaggerated claims as Amazon drops...
item.description:
@undefined

The tax mitigation industry is now just as much about hype and exaggerated claims as Amazon dropshipping, affiliate marketing, business coaches coaching business coaches how to coach business coaches, AI agencies, and AirBNB courses. What’s especially sad is that accountants are being taught to ignore fundamentals of finance in order to promote themselves. They should know better. Willful ignorance should not be a business strategy. For example, promoting tax savings in year one from a timing benefit and charging a fee based on that benefit, and ignoring the resultant future year tax increases. Not to mention the outright fraud being promoted in the form of sketchy advice around paying infants a salary, abusing the Augusta rule, deducting clothing and gym memberships just because you are on camera, or ignoring case law when it comes to S Corp salaries, travel expenses and meals/entertainment. Ethical tax accountants are being told every day that they are suckers for doing work for their clients for a reasonable fee, and instead they should sell overpriced/overhyped tax plans and misrepresent the benefits and legality of the strategies. Don’t even get me started on irrevocable nongrantor discretionary spendthrift trusts. People tell me every day I should just focus on my own stuff and stop paying attention to what other people are doing or promoting. But CPAs rely on trust that has been established over decades, and if no one says anything, then that trust the public has in our profession gets eroded. And bad actors get away with it. Then we get lumped in with insurance salesmen. Which makes otherwise good actors question why they are playing by the rules. At least we have @TaxLeverage fighting the good fight, but we need more than one person in the industry standing up for professionalism and “actual tax law”. It’s absolutely necessary to call out the bullshit when you see it.

🧠 STRATEGIC OVERVIEW (High IQ Version) Thesis: The traditional AliExpress-to-Shopify dropshipping is dead. You win today by owning demand (distribution) and controlling perception (brand). Dropshipping is just supply chain arbitrage. We're scaling a high-margin, fast-moving consumer brand using dropshipping as a launch mechanism—not the endgame. ⚙️ THE SYSTEM (9-Figure Stack) We’re building a vertically integrated demand engine with 3 systems: Front-End Growth Machine (Acquisition) Conversion System (Website + Offer) Back-End Profit Engine (LTV + Logistics) 1. FRONT-END GROWTH MACHINE Own attention. Then redirect it like a warlord. A. Niche Selection (Profit Arbitrage) Don’t sell trinkets. Sell painkillers, ego boosters, or money-makers. Go for High TAM, high perceived value, low brand competition. Examples: Weight loss gadgets Tactical gear for men Pet anxiety solutions Self-defense for women ADHD / productivity gear B. Traffic Source Domination We choose 1 channel and master it. You’ll scale through paid media + virality. ChannelExecution PriorityTikTok OrganicFast, free, hooks-basedTikTok Ads$0–$10K test budgetYouTube AdsLong-form + retargetingMeta AdsBroad + retargetingInfluencersPlug into existing trust Tactic: Hook-based virality. Make people stop scrolling with one-liner pain point or a pattern interrupt. 2. CONVERSION SYSTEM The offer is the product. The site just exists to remove friction. A. Offer Crafting (Irresistible) High perceived value ($100+) but $20–40 COGS Stack bonuses, scarcity, and outcomes, not features Structure: 🧠 Position around transformation ("Fix XYZ in 14 Days") 💰 Bundle digital upsells (PDFs, courses, coaching) ⏱️ Urgency via timers, limited supply 🎯 UGC testimonials on landing page B. Landing Page (Speed + Trust) Single product funnel: zero distractions Obsess over: Hero image + clear headline Testimonials above the fold Guarantee + FAQs + urgency Mobile-first loading in <2s 3. BACK-END PROFIT ENGINE 9-figure businesses are built on repeat buyers, not one-hit wonders. A. LTV Multipliers Email + SMS flows from Day 1 Abandoned cart Post-purchase upsells Subscription pitch Digital continuity: eBooks, apps, memberships B. Supply Chain Test with CJ Dropshipping / Zendrop Scale with private supplier via 3PL Once proven: white label → OEM → branded packaging 🧱 PHASED EXECUTION PLAN PhaseObjectiveTimelinePhase 1Validate OfferWeek 1–2Phase 2Build Landing FunnelWeek 2–3Phase 3Launch TikTok Organic + AdsWeek 3–5Phase 4Optimize AOV + LTVWeek 6–8Phase 5Private Supplier + BrandMonth 2–3Phase 6Scale via Media Buying TeamMonth 3+ 💣 CRITICAL NON-NEGOTIABLES Hook = Everything — Test 50 angles, not 5. Speed to Feedback — Launch ugly, iterate fast. Daily KPIs — Track CAC, AOV, ROAS, LTV Customer Obsession — Reviews, unboxing, returns—optimize it all. Leverage Teams — Hire UGC creators, media buyers, ops early. 💡 FINAL WORD This isn’t about Shopify stores or side hustles. This is brand arbitrage, demand capture, and psychology at scale. If you want me to build out specific product ideas, ad scripts, funnel templates, or a dashboard with key KPIs, just say the word. Ready to move? Let’s pick a niche or define the product. After that I was on a bad streak of a few months, I was literally asking myself "How I did this in the past?", I joined twitter and realized that I was just rich in my town between guys of my age, I was the poorest guy here in the community, @ecomversace was doing 100k/d consistently for months, that humbled me real quick and I thank god for making me join here, I don't even know how it happened cause I didn't even used twitter, ego was canalized again and I started to study the game more deeply, best thing that ever happened to me was not comparing myself to the guys around my circle/town or letting them know how much I was worth so they wouldn't say "Oh you are rich" and let all that inflate my ego and stop the grind, seen this happen dozens of times

item.title:
0-650k/Month Case Study - Google Dropshipping
Date: 16/04/2025 Time: 08:30pm CET Link: https://...
item.description:
@undefined

0-650k/Month Case Study - Google Dropshipping Date: 16/04/2025 Time: 08:30pm CET Link: https://t.co/wTaIoVP3c3 Joep and I started working together exactly 1 year ago. Before that time we were doing 1-300k per month with Meta dropshipping. When we started the cooperation, Joep had one Google Store approved and asked "what do you think, should we run this store or leave it?" on what we both said "let's do it and see where it goes". That decision changed our whole path of e-com. Month after month we were getting better results. April 2024: 220k May 2024: 330k June 2024: 480k July 2024: 700k And after that, we never went one month under 500k in revenue and were stable doing between 700-800k EUR in revenue. Revenue looks nice, but it all comes down to profit at the end. We ended the year with good profits, but we had a lot of obstacles.. We were used to running dropshipping stores while having agencies for our backend (CS, SC and Disputes). In Q3 last year, running with agencies literally made us lose close to 300k. What we saw with that agency is that they didn't care about the response times or the refunds that are being done. When that happened we mentioned to eachother that it's not going to happen ever again and we switched to getting it in house. This was the best decision EVER. From having up to 20% in refund rates with an agency, to max 6.5% while having it on our own (with healthy chargeback and dispute rates). We saw we can scale easily and make good profits on the frontend. But we had to make sure we could keep scaling profitably and keeping our processors happy. This is exactly what we did. In this casestudy you will see how we achieved 0-650k/month after only a few months of our first Google store and how we did it. Joep made this video; my business partner, brother and one of the most inspiring individuals. Watch this video closely, this is a life changer. Enjoy guys! - Wesley
